title: A separable algebraic extension embeds into a separably closed extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $M/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and let $\Omega/k$ be a field extension such that $\Omega$ is separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed]. Then there is a homomorphism of $k$-algebras $\sigma:M\to\Omega$ (necessarily injective, $M$ being a field).

source.place: Fields, Lemma 09GU (fields-lemma-map-into-algebraic-closure, line 1023), whose Zorn argument applies verbatim with 'separable algebraic' and 'separably closed' in place of 'algebraic' and 'algebraically closed' (the minimal polynomial of alpha over a subextension E divides its separable minimal polynomial over k, hence is separable, so its image has a root in Omega); Stacks states only the algebraically closed case. Mathlib: IsSepClosed.lift
